hints.title: Ratio Graph Consistency
hints.text: Each equation A / B = v creates a directed relationship with multiplicative weight between nodes A and B.

hints.title: Disjoint Set with Multiplicative Weights
hints.text: Maintain the parent of each variable along with the ratio value / parent_value.

hints.title: Floating Point Tolerance Check
hints.text: When uniting two already connected variables, compare the expected ratio to the existing ratio with an epsilon tolerance.

hints.title: Weighted Disjoint Set Implementation

complexity.notes: Weighted union-find with path compression runs in near-linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Running full graph search per equation is redundant when disjoint set maintains path ratios.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Parent and ratio dictionaries store entries for distinct variables.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate updates cumulative ratio weights during find path compression and handles floating point precision with epsilon.
